title: Coverage list
responsibility: Shows a report’s acceptance criteria and coverage checks.

inputs.name: CoverageList.report
inputs.description: Required report containing acceptance strings and coverage items with title, status and optional viewport/detail.

inputs.name: CoverageList.section
inputs.description: Optional all, acceptance or coverage, default all, selecting which portions render.

inputs.name: CoverageList.embedded
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True removes panel styling and section headings and adds the localized section name as an accessible label.

outputs.name: CoverageList
outputs.description: Acceptance list and/or coverage check rows with status badges. Coverage is omitted when empty; there is no extra empty-state message. Does not assess criteria itself.
